hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels (validateQuantityAtLocation loop, lines 173-191) checks each reservation input against level.available_quantity independently and never sums inputs sharing an (inventory_item_id, location_id). Two carts that each hold WIDGET on multiple lines (a piece and a two-pack) and are completed together should both pass the per-line check against a stock of 10 level, with reserved totals exceeding 10, so no_oversell should fail in some runs. Carts with a combined need above stock (cart A: 5 pieces; cart B: 3 pieces + 2 two-packs = 7 pieces-equivalent units, total 12 > 10) are the target.

  cart: bob
